notes.title: ESDigital Games Heads to Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]ESDigital Games[/b] is heading to [b]Tokyo Game Show 2024[/b]! From [b]September 26th to 29th[/b], we will be presenting a wide selection of exciting titles from our portfolio. With support from our distribution partners, we’ll have hands-on demos available for attendees, along with the chance to take photos with cosplayers inspired by our games!
We will be present across four booths at the show, with demos in multiple languages. Whether you're a fan of action, strategy, or adventure, we have something for everyone.

[previewyoutube=zpa0_iifUpk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Here’s where you can find us at Tokyo Game Show:[/h1]

[h2]ESDigital Games - Booth 09-W11[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384060/BattleJuice_Alchemist/

[h2]Gamersky - Booth 09-W84[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458430/Steel_Seed/

[h2]Game Source Entertainment - Booth 08-C08[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447260/Cats_on_Duty/

We’re also excited to announce that a representative from [b]Dark Pigeon Games[/b], the team behind [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b], will be at our booths during the business days ([b]September 26 and 27[/b]) and will be available for interviews and questions.
Come visit us, try our games, and don't miss the chance to connect with our amazing development teams!

notes.title: Sky of Tides Joins Game Devs of Color Expo 2024 with Exciting Streams!
notes.content:
[b]Sky of Tides[/b] is participating in the [b]Game Devs of Color Expo 2024[/b] (GDoCExpo) with a series of [b]exclusive streams[/b] on its Steam page! Mark your calendars for two exciting broadcasts during the event:
[list]
[*] [b]Thursday, September 19 at 7 PM EST - Stream by Shrum
[*] Saturday, September 21 at 2 PM EST - Stream by spacevalkyries[/b]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

During these streams, developers from [b]Lofty Sky Entertainment[/b], creators of Sky of Tides and Shuyan Saga, will be joining the chat to answer questions and engage with the community. Don't miss this chance to connect with the dev team directly while enjoying the game's stunning world!

notes.title: Stellar Roster of Voice Talent Revealed for Sky of Tides!
notes.content:
We are happy to share the roster of talented [b]voice actors[/b] featured in [b]Sky of Tides[/b] and the animated series set in the same universe, [b]Sky of Tides: ATLA[/b]. The cast of each contains voices recognized from television, anime and other popular video games!

Among the best known cast of the Sky of Tides game and series are American voice actor and director [b]Todd Haberkorn[/b], who has voiced characters in many popular anime and games including [b]Dragon Ball Z[/b] and [b]Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3[/b]. He brings the role of [b]Lu D’Lorah[/b] – father of the game’s main character, to life, and voices [b]Commander Ox[/b] in the animated series. [b]Damien Hass[/b], a familiar face from [b]Smosh Games[/b] and the [b]Damien & Shayne Show[/b], as well as the voice of several characters from the show Clarence and games including [b]Grand Theft Auto V[/b], [b]Halo Wars 2[/b], and [b]Fortnite[/b], is the voice of [b]Reef[/b] in the [b]Sky of Tides[/b] game.

Also notable are ex-USAF officer-turned voice actor and author, [b]Joe Zieja[/b], whose works include [b]Fire Emblem: Three Houses[/b] and [b]Just Cause 4[/b]. He voices the role of [b]Streak[/b] in the game. And popular variety streamer [b]Briana “Storymodebae” Williams[/b] joins the cast, voicing the character of [b]Drifty No-Hive[/b] in both the game and animated series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

In addition to the actors mentioned above, the cast of the game and/or the series includes:
[list]
[*] Zoleka Vundla voices the character Nikki in the game.
[*] Caleb Yen voices the character of Kryll in the series.
[*] Tricia Brioux brings the role of Chairman to life in both the game and series.
[*] Chelly Li performs the role of Yana in the series.
[*] Conrad Haynes performs the role of Thrace in the game.
[*] David Shatraw voices the character of Loaj in the game.
[*] Mark Graue performs the role of Rin’s grandfather, Kenneth Sohan in the game.
[*] B Marks voices the character Sage Sid in the game and Dr. Ugane in the series.
[*] Brent Mukai, as Sage Opaldeen in the series.
[/list]
As an entrée into the world of Sky of Tides, [b]Lofty Sky Entertainment[/b] will release nine audio diaries or novellas providing backstory for each of the main characters. Players can sign up to receive these novellas on the [b][url=https://skyoftides.com/#char-title]NEW Sky of Tides site[/url][/b].
